questions.stem_text: Which one of the following statements is false?

options.A: Protocol 14 established the Human Rights Council
options.B: Protocol 14 mandated a two judge formation for hearing admissibility cases
options.C: Protocol 14 reduced the jurisdiction of the European Court of Human Rights
options.D: Protocol 14 shortened the judicial term of office for the European Court of Human Rights
options.E: Protocol 14 introduced a requirement for unanimous decision-making in admissibility cases

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Protocol 14 established the Human Rights Council

questions.stem_text:
The most likely contract to be classified under the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) is a
contract for

options.A: The purchase of a commercial property building.
options.B: A contract for hiring a live-in nanny.
options.C: The purchase of stocks and bonds.
options.D: Crops and timber to be severed from the property next summer.
options.E: A common carrier delivering a new computer.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Crops and timber to be severed from the property next summer.

questions.stem_text:
The ________ School of jurisprudence believes that the law is an aggregate of social
traditions and customs that have developed over the centuries.

Which of the following quotations best describes the central thesis of difference
feminism?

options.A: Men are unable to comprehend their differences from women.'
options.B: Men and women have different conceptions of the feminist project.'
options.C: Women look to context, whereas men appeal to neutral, abstract notions of justice.'
options.D: 'Women and men have identical perspectives on justice.'
options.E: 'Feminism is about eradicating differences between men and women.'

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Women look to context, whereas men appeal to neutral, abstract notions of justice.'
